text:
rachel_support: Escalation from Support -> Nyx Labs (nyx-342). Onboarding blocked: sample ingest fails with schema validation. They have a paid POC + demo tomorrow. Error: 'user_id: expected string'.

maya_cs: Thanks. Can you paste the failing payload and SDK version? I'll prep a customer note and set a 4hr SLA.

rachel_support: Payload snippet: ```{
  "user_id": {"id": 42},
  "email": "qa@nyx.com"
}``` SDK: js v2.1.0. Customer prefers server-side fix.

sam_se: Assigning. Hypothesis: some clients send nested id objects. Options: relax validation or coerce at ingest. I'll try a small coercion shim on ingress. ETA ~2-3h incl canary.

liam_csm: Impact: 6 trial seats, expected ARR if converted. If >6h mark renewal-risk and notify AE. I'll prep CRM note and renewal-watch.

infra_bot: provisioning: created staging env nyx-342-stg.

sam_se: Pushed branch ingest-coerce-nyx. Unit tests pass. Requesting canary.

infra_bot: canary: 2 instances running smoke checks.

sam_se: Canary passed. Ingest now accepts object by stringifying nested id. No regressions in schema tests. Scheduling 5% prod rollout.

maya_cs: Draft message to customer: "Hi Sarah — we found the cause (nested id objects). We're deploying a targeted fix; ETA ~3 hours. Short-term: stringify user_id on client or use our temp endpoint. We'll update when rollout is verified. — Maya"

liam_csm: Add rollback info and offer to reschedule demo if they'd like. I set renewal-watch and alerted AE.

rachel_support: Sent workaround & temp endpoint to customer. They applied workaround and report partial success.

sam_se: 5% rollout healthy. Increasing to 25%. Monitoring shows validation failures for nyx-342 drop to 0.

maya_cs: Sending +2h update and scheduling follow-up. If not resolved by EOD escalate to AE + CRO.

liam_csm: Customer confirmed demo can proceed after final rollout. I'll log postmortem action: update SDK docs re: id formatting and capture feedback for product validation policy.

maya_cs: Closing thread after customer confirmation. Good cross-team response.
